City demand

Demand for new housing

Low, medium and high density grow independently. Empty homes and construction reduce the need for more buildings; residents can still move into available homes.

Road-connected housing only. Capacity is measured in resident places. Factor scores combine into a demand value between 0 and 100. Mixed-use growth also needs commercial demand.

Autosave runs every 5 minutes while a city is open, including when paused. A closed browser cannot run the game. Saves are checked after writing.

Your first city

  1. Connect the roads. Extend the starter road by clicking and dragging. Your road network must reach the map edge. Open Views → Traffic, then Show outside connection.
  2. Bring in utilities. Place a power station and a water tower beside connected roads.
  3. Zone a neighborhood. Choose detached homes, row houses, apartments, mixed-use, low-rent blocks or towers. Paint along a road; several 8 m squares form one building lot. Use Along road to set lot depth. Open City demand to see which housing densities are needed, then zone shops and industry for jobs.
  4. Meet their needs. Add parks, education, healthcare, police, fire protection and waste services as your city grows.
  5. Keep a balanced budget. Check your daily income and adjust taxes in Economy.

Residents & households

Every resident has a saved home and routine. Residents walk along connected paths and sidewalks, ride buses, or drive. Blocked journeys wait for access. Locate shows their current position.
